categories.main_business_segments: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of high-purity polysilicon, which is a key upstream material in the photovoltaic (solar energy) industry. The company also produces silicon core products, trichlorosilane, silicon tetrachloride, sodium hydroxide, hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite, and processes silicon iron, silicon manganese, silicon powder, and silicon alloys. It operates in the solar photovoltaic materials manufacturing sector, focusing on high-purity polysilicon for solar and semiconductor applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses the improved Siemens process combined with cold hydrogenation technology to produce high-purity polysilicon. Key technological advancements include high-efficiency chlorosilane purification, cold hydrogenation fluidized bed optimization, intelligent control of reduction furnaces, and advanced distillation control systems. The company emphasizes digitalization, automation, and intelligent manufacturing to reduce costs and improve product quality and energy efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are downstream silicon wafer manufacturers in the photovoltaic industry, including producers of monocrystalline and polycrystalline silicon wafers. The company serves mainly the solar energy sector, with products used in solar cells and photovoltaic modules. It also targets semiconductor-grade polysilicon markets, aiming to break foreign monopolies and expand into high-end applications such as semiconductor materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with production bases in Xinjiang and Inner Mongolia. It also actively expands its overseas market presence, establishing long-term cooperation with multiple foreign customers to diversify market risks. Domestic sales cover regions including North China, Northwest China, Southwest China, East China, South China, Northeast China, and Central China, with a small portion of sales overseas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy is positioned upstream in the photovoltaic supply chain as a manufacturer of high-purity polysilicon, the essential raw material for silicon wafers. It procures industrial silicon powder and other raw materials and supplies polysilicon directly to silicon wafer manufacturers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and cost reduction through R&D in energy-efficient production processes, impurity removal, and digital manufacturing. It invests heavily in developing N-type polysilicon, semiconductor-grade polysilicon, and related high-purity silicon materials. The strategic focus includes digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, global market expansion, and sustainable low-carbon production aligned with national energy and environmental policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-purity polysilicon products to downstream silicon wafer manufacturers under long-term supply agreements and sales contracts. The company also earns income from by-products generated during polysilicon production. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance, with pricing often negotiated monthly within long-term contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading polysilicon producers in China, holding approximately 11.26% of the domestic polysilicon production market in 2024, placing it in the industry's first tier. It competes with other major domestic polysilicon manufacturers, focusing on cost leadership, product quality, and technological innovation to maintain competitive advantages amid industry overcapacity and price pressures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 7.41 billion, a 54.62% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.72 billion, reflecting significant profit decline due to falling polysilicon prices and market oversupply. The company has total assets of about RMB 44.2 billion and equity of RMB 40.16 billion, with a strong cash reserve of approximately RMB 13.52 billion. Despite the downturn, the company continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy emphasizes high-quality, low-energy-consumption, and low-cost production of high-purity polysilicon, achieving industry-leading product quality with over 98% of products meeting electronic-grade standards. The company leverages advanced proprietary technologies, digital and intelligent manufacturing systems, and strong cost control to provide reliable, high-purity polysilicon products that support downstream customers' needs for high-performance silicon wafers, thereby creating sustainable competitive advantages.
